item.title: PIRATES OF THE CARIBBEAN Reboot May Pair Up Johnny Depp's Jack Sparrow With Margot Robbie
item.description: A new Pirates of the Caribbean rumour suggests Disney does indeed plan on bringing Johnny Depp back as Captain Jack Sparrow, pairing the actor up with Margot Robbie's mystery character.

item.title: AVENGERS: DOOMSDAY Rumors Shed New Light On Plans For Loki And Members Of The Young Avengers
item.description: New Avengers: Doomsday rumours claim to reveal plans for Loki and the Young Avengers/Champions in the upcoming movie, including how much we'll see of Tom Hiddleston's God of Stories.

item.title: RUMOR: Sony Pictures' Animated VENOM Movie Is Targeting An R-Rating
item.description: Sony Pictures is moving forward with an animated Venom movie, and according to a new rumour, the Lethal Protector's big screen return won't head down the same route as the family-friendly Spider-Verse.

item.title: MCU's Rumored New Black Panther, Damson Idris, Stars In Awesome Trailer For 2026 Formula 1 Season
item.description: F1: The Movie star Damson Idris narrates a newly released trailer for the 2026 Formula 1 season that, even if you're not already a fan, will definitely get you excited for lights out in Melbourne.
